g.text: Peer 0 denotes the initiator role for this ceremony, not a fixed setup index.
Peer-indexed collections contain exactly one entry per setup peer in setup order.
Guards and detailed-message coverage are in withdrawal_development_contracts.md.
WI-REVIEW-2 PSBT and current local block height
Independently accept under G-WITHDRAWAL-PRECONDITIONS and G-PSBT-AUTHORIZATION.
Derive tx_id, create fresh ST review nonce, IDLE -> REVIEWING_TX.
Derive withdrawal_id from setup_instance_id, tx_id, initiator identity, and fresh approval nonce.
WI-APPROVE-1 withdrawal_id, Enc_WT(Sig_Boomlet(TxApproval_0)), Enc_Boomlet_i(PSBT) x4 via Niso
WI-APPROVE-2 WtTxApproval, initiator TxApproval, recipient-encrypted PSBT
Accept under G-TX-APPROVAL-COLLECTION; canonicalize in setup peer order
WI-APPROVE-4 ordered five TxApprovals and WtTxApproval via Niso
approved_withdrawal_id := H(withdrawal_id, exact ordered five-approval set).
Fresh nonce-bound challenge; valid response yields safe or duress placeholder plaintext.
Create Sig_Boomlet(TxCommit_0) and fresh approved_withdrawal_id-bound Placeholder_0
Authenticate, verify, and stage initiator commit
G-APPROVAL-ATTESTATIONS opens only with one valid matching attestation from every non-initiator.
The open gate permits initiator placeholder relay, initiator commit acknowledgment,
Accept and durably process under G-SAR-PLACEHOLDER; release at the fixed observable deadline
WI-COMMIT-7 each non-initiator Placeholder_i to its setup-bound SAR
Accept every commit and SAR acknowledgment under G-TX-COMMIT-AT-WT
WI-COMMIT-9 complete WT-signed TxCommit set and acknowledgment_0 via Niso
Revalidate complete set and exact own acknowledgment under G-COMMIT-COLLECTION.
Draw one fresh private mystery only on DIGGING entry.
Initialize counter := 0, ping_seq_num := 0, reached := false, last_seen_block := local block height.
[Until WT holds one current reached ping from every peer]
WI-DIG-1 Enc_WT(Sig_Boomlet(Ping_0 + freshly encrypted Placeholder_0)) via Niso
WI-DIG-2 corresponding Ping_i and fresh Placeholder_i x4
Handle exact retries under SPEC 15.7; return after receipt-only delivery.
Accept each new ping under G-PING-AT-WT.
A ping contributes to a pong only after its exact acknowledgment.
Enforce round spacing; construct recipient-specific Pong_i from current signed pings of all other peers.
Prevalidate visible pong and collection properties under G-PONG-AT-BOOMLET
Boomlet performs any requested consent rotation.
[After rotation or when selected by the profile cadence]
Consume one fresh phase-bound response and update placeholder plaintext.
Increment only if the local chain advanced and every other current ping is within the local freshness window.
Apply bounded last_seen_block catch-up after every valid pong, including no-progress rounds.
Record reached flags monotonically; set local reached when counter >= mystery; increment ping_seq_num.
Freshly encrypt the current placeholder plaintext for the next ping.
A reached Boomlet continues participating until all five current reached pings are collected.
Hydrate the PSBT without changing transaction semantics, ordering, sighash policy, or tx_id.
WI-SIGN-2 mnemonic, passphrase, network, account, key index
READY_TO_SIGN -> SIGNING; create session-bound Boomlet nonce
WI-SIGN-4 verified signing package and Boomlet public nonce
WI-SIGN-5 normal public nonce and normal partial signature
Verify normal partial; create Boomlet partial; erase nonce material
Verify Boomlet partial, finalize peer fragment, erase nonce material
Boomlet sends a final ping and waits for its exact SAR receipt and any required backup reset acknowledgment.
Clear active withdrawal state and mystery; SIGNATURE_EXPORTED -> IDLE.
Accept under G-FINAL-FRAGMENTS; aggregate and verify the exact committed tx_id
Invalid identity, signature, envelope, nonce, ceremony binding, sequence, block-height relation,
collection, transaction, or state transition stalls the active ceremony.
